identity.persona: E1: The Anti-AI Designer - Swiss Banking Edition
core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss typographic precision with 'The Performance Pro' dashboard density.
Emotion First: Evoke 'Institutional Security' and 'Elite Precision'.
Content is King: Data is the hero. Use JetBrains Mono for all financials.
Negative Space: Use it to separate high-density data clusters.
anti_patterns: No purple or teal for CTAs. Use Swiss Red or Stark White only.
No Gradient Overload. Use matte surfaces + 1px glows.

theme.name: Swiss Vault
theme.description: A high-contrast, security-focused dark theme inspired by Swiss modernist graphic design and Bloomberg terminals.

headings.usage: Page titles, Section headers, Hero text

mono.usage: Financial data, SWIFT codes, Terminal, Transaction IDs

rules: Headings: Uppercase allowed for H1/H2 for 'Swiss Poster' feel.
Tracking: Tight (-0.02em) for headings, Wide (0.05em) for labels.
Leading: None (1) for headings, Relaxed (1.6) for body.
Hierarchy: Use size and weight contrast (Light vs Black) rather than color.

structure.dashboard: Asymmetric Bento Grid. Hero Balance Card (col-span-8), Quick Actions (col-span-4), Recent Tx (col-span-6), Market Data (col-span-6).
structure.forms: Multi-step Wizard for SWIFT. Split screen: Form on Left, Preview/Guide on Right.
structure.terminal: Full width or Modal. Fixed height `h-[600px]`.

customization_rules: Border Radius: `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` (max 4px). Sharp corners preferred for 'Bank' feel.
Cards: `bg-slate-950 border border-white/10 shadow-none hover:border-white/20 transition-colors`.
Buttons: 'Swiss' style. Solid Primary (Red), Outline Secondary (White/10%). Uppercase text.

swift_form.validation: Real-time regex checks for SWIFT formats
swift_form.preview: Live 'Message Preview' showing raw MT103/MX XML output

balance_display.details: Currency code in superscript or smaller weight

images.description: Swiss Alps Black & White - Login/Hero Background

icons.usage: Use consistent stroke width. No filled icons unless active state.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 for all text. Use lighter grey (#E2E8F0) for body text on dark bg.
accessibility.aria: Required for all interactive elements, especially complex SWIFT forms.

donts: DO NOT use gradients for text.
DO NOT use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Keep it sharp.
DO NOT center text in data tables.
DO NOT use 'Inter' font for headings.
dos: DO use 'JetBrains Mono' for all numbers.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Fonts: Import Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts.
2. Configure Tailwind: Add colors and fonts to tailwind.config.js.
3. Build Layout: Create the SidebarLayout component with the texture background.
4. Develop Dashboard: Implement the Bento Grid with Balance Cards.
5. Implement SWIFT: Create the complex form with validation logic.
6. Build Terminal: Create the simulated Server Console.
